description: This file defines the `RemoteTunnelManager` actor responsible for managing SSH tunnels for remote gateway control. It handles starting, stopping, and reusing SSH tunnels, with logging and restart backoff mechanisms.

classes.name: RemoteTunnelManager
classes.description: An actor that manages SSH tunnels for remote gateway control, including starting, stopping, and reuse logic.

methods.name: controlTunnelPortIfRunning
methods.description: Checks if a control tunnel port is active and returns it if so; otherwise, triggers a restart.

methods.name: ensureControlTunnel
methods.description: Ensures that an SSH control tunnel is established, creating one if necessary, and returns the local port.

methods.name: stopAll
methods.description: Terminates any active control SSH tunnel.

methods.name: isSshProcess
methods.description: Determines if a given process descriptor corresponds to an SSH process.

methods.name: beginRestart
methods.description: Initiates a restart process for the SSH tunnel with backoff logic.

methods.name: endRestart
methods.description: Marks the end of a restart attempt for the SSH tunnel.

methods.name: waitForRestartBackoffIfNeeded
methods.description: Waits if a recent restart was performed, respecting backoff timing.
